workloads.label: neox-1d-4k-d128-bf16
workloads.reason: no per-shape structural gain left: tiling unchanged (52 rows, 2 waves, n_num=79 = optimal integer-wave fit at 40 cores); larger tile (69 rows) only helps 8k's 3-wave geometry. Round-4 candidates: r4_prefetch 4.76 us single-run looked like +2.7% but the 5-run interleaved A/B returned tie and was in fact 2.75% SLOWER (4.73 vs 4.86, 3/5 pairs slower, p=1.0) while aiv_time/vec_time regressed; r4_fuseup (fused cross-dtype cast copies) 5.10 us = -4.3% (rollback); r4_vcastslice blocked at compile time (R-8: v-op targets must be whole buffers). Final record 4.78 us on the unchanged r3 artifact.
